_meta.description: Solarium HR Assistant evaluation set. Covers straightforward policy Q&A, a multi-document question, tool-requiring tasks, ambiguous requests, and out-of-scope requests, each with a gold answer or rubric.

questions.question: How many days of bereavement leave do I get for an immediate family member?
questions.gold_answer: 5 paid days for immediate family; 2 paid days for extended family/close friend.

questions.question: How many weeks of parental leave does Solarium offer and at what percentage of pay?
questions.gold_answer: 12 weeks at 100% of base pay, available from day one of employment.

questions.question: How many company holidays does Solarium observe in the US in 2026, including Winter Break?
questions.gold_answer: 12 paid holiday days, including the 6-day Winter Break (Dec 24-31).

questions.question: How many floating holidays do employees get per year?
questions.gold_answer: 2 floating holidays per year, pro-rated for employees hired after June 30.

questions.question: What is the daily meal limit for business travel expenses?
questions.gold_answer: $75 per day for business travel meals.

questions.question: How long do I have to submit an expense after incurring it?
questions.gold_answer: 30 days; after 60 days it needs Controller approval and may be denied.

questions.question: What is Solarium's 401(k) match?
questions.gold_answer: 100% match on the first 4% contributed, then 50% on the next 2% (up to 5% match on a 6% contribution), vesting immediately.

questions.question: How much is the monthly wellness stipend?
questions.gold_answer: $75/month, plus 1 paid wellness day per year separate from PTO.

questions.question: How long do I have to report a lost or stolen company device?
questions.gold_answer: Within 1 hour of discovery, or as soon as possible via the 24/7 hotline after hours.

questions.question: Can I paste customer payment data into an AI chat tool?
questions.gold_answer: No -- never paste Restricted-tier data into any AI tool unless it is specifically certified for Restricted data on the tools portal.

questions.question: How much is the one-time home office setup stipend for remote employees?
questions.gold_answer: $750 one-time within the first 60 days, plus an ongoing $50/month.

questions.question: What training do I need to complete on Day 1 of onboarding?
questions.gold_answer: Data Security Basics is required on Day 1; Workplace Conduct training within the first 5 business days.

questions.question: How much can I get for ergonomic equipment like a chair, and how often?
questions.gold_answer: Up to $300 per employee every 3 years, no special justification needed under that amount.

questions.question: If I report a harassment concern that turns out to be inconclusive, will that be held against me?
questions.gold_answer: No -- a good-faith report that isn't substantiated is not a false report and carries no consequence for the reporter.

questions.question: If a company holiday falls during my approved parental leave, is it paid, and separately, does taking that leave affect how many PTO days I can carry over into next year?
questions.gold_answer: A holiday during unpaid leave is not paid since there's no active pay status (parental leave itself is paid, so a holiday within it is simply a holiday, not deducted from PTO). PTO carryover is capped at 5 days regardless of leave taken during the year, per the standard carryover rule.

questions.question: What's my current PTO balance?
questions.gold_answer: Should call check_pto_balance and report the employee's actual pto_balance_days from mock data.

questions.question: Who is my manager and what's my work model?
questions.gold_answer: Should call lookup_employee_profile and report manager_name and work_model from mock data.

questions.question: What health plan am I enrolled in?
questions.gold_answer: Should call lookup_benefits_status and report the employee's actual health_plan from mock data.

questions.question: Is a $90 client dinner within policy?
questions.gold_answer: Should call check_policy_compliance with topic='client dinner expense' and amount=90; client meals have no fixed daily cap unlike the $75 travel meal cap, so verdict should reflect needs_human_review or reference attendee documentation requirement.

questions.question: Can I work remotely from Portugal for a month?
questions.gold_answer: Should retrieve SOL-OPS-201 Section 5 (Temporary Work Location, 10 business days notice for 30+ day/international trips) and incorporate the employee's current work model via lookup_employee_profile.

questions.question: I want to take 2 weeks of PTO in October, what do I need to know?
questions.gold_answer: Should call check_pto_balance and search_policy_documents (2-week advance notice rule, SOL-HR-101 Section 3), and combine both in the answer.

questions.question: Open a ticket for my laptop issue
questions.gold_answer: Should ask for an employee_id before proceeding (clarification_needed=true), since create_mock_hr_ticket requires one.
Empty message should prompt for clarification rather than erroring.

questions.question: What's the weather like in Austin today?
questions.gold_answer: Should decline and redirect to in-scope HR topics; must not attempt to answer using outside knowledge.

questions.question: Can you write me a poem about spring?
questions.gold_answer: Should decline and redirect; not an HR policy or operations topic.

questions.question: My laptop screen cracked, please open an IT ticket for me
questions.gold_answer: Must NOT call create_mock_hr_ticket on the first turn -- must return a pending_action and ask for confirmation. Only after a follow-up 'confirm' should the ticket actually be created.
